Dimension-three fixed-off-diagonal learn:high-moment, conditional on any positive-probability own-cell schedule, under exactly the prepared-input, typical-pencil and scale hypotheses of sections 01-03 (September 24, 2026 staged version).

definitions.conditional_input: Counts at the center are zero, own-cell point-batch counts are fixed, remaining radial line-batch counts are independent Poisson of mean L a_l.
definitions.uniformity: All prepared supports and all positive-probability fixed own-cell schedules; sufficiently large prime q, uniformly over the allowed D interval.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 170 (Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers.; papers: The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t); Sharp logarithmic exponents for fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/170.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Obtain an independently reviewed universal verification of the dimension-three conditional high-moment implication, or an exact admissible refutation; the full Ramsey construction remains open.

For every prepared dimension-three input outside D0 union D1 union D2 and every positive-probability fixed own-cell schedule O_x, E[(T_x^*)^p | O_x] <= B^p exp(-pP/10), for all sufficiently large prime q (learn:high-moment, sections/03-learning.tex:366-372). Supplied prior status: untested.

For any finite ordered tuple, including repeated hyperplanes, E product_i(I_Hi-b)=sum over subsets A of tuple positions of (-b)^(p-|A|) exp(-L mass(union_{i in A} H_i)); fixed own-cell schedules only supply zero-one factors.

External-schedule conditioning yields exp(-.7P) per nonsimple component and exp(-.68P)(|delta_H|^(R/2)+(p theta_max)^200+1_BH) per simple singleton, uniformly in fixed own-cell schedules, at the stated large-q scales.

Every simultaneous residual hit event has a static anchor/pair/root certificate with O(p) dictionary directions and distinct charged direction-batch events; no adaptive hit is charged as an independent fresh event.

Using the prepared overlap bounds and unique plane through two distinct radial directions, the normalized weighted component/certificate sum has exp(o(pP)) overhead and at least exp(-.34pP) pre-overhead attenuation.
The manuscript parameter interval makes the explicit finite numerical hypotheses of the conditional high-moment mechanism hold uniformly as prime q tends to infinity.
The preceding geometric preparation and regular-pencil estimates supply the learning section input bounds. This source assertion is outside the present implication audit and is not certified.
Short-row implementation, marking, context replacement, entropy, decoding and iteration establish the claimed full Ramsey lower construction. Supplied prior status: untested; separate from PC_HM.
For each fixed s >= 6 and epsilon > 0, r(s,t) >= t^(s-1)/(log t)^(s-2+epsilon) for all sufficiently large t, as asserted in intro:main. Supplied prior status: untested.

The companion eq:ambient-high-moment states E[T_x^p 1_Gx] <= B^p exp(-pP/10) with its high-case truncation and own-cell union mass at most .08. It is not identical to the untruncated fixed-off-diagonal estimate. Supplied prior status: untested.

For all finite atom systems, arbitrary finite weighted hit laws and arbitrary lists of tested subsets (including repetitions), the recursive union expansion equals the centered mixed moment. Restricted nonnegative weighted direction-pair sums admit marginal-product enlargement, and the root/nonsimple exponent comparisons hold. This does not formalize the full probabilistic high-moment theorem.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace PoissonCore

variable {α Ω β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

noncomputable def vacant (u hits : Finset α) : ℝ :=
  if Disjoint u hits then 1 else 0

theorem vacant_empty (hits : Finset α) : vacant ∅ hits = 1 := by
  simp [vacant]

theorem vacant_union (u v hits : Finset α) :
    vacant (u ∪ v) hits = vacant u hits * vacant v hits := by
  classical
  by_cases hu : Disjoint u hits <;> by_cases hv : Disjoint v hits <;>
    simp [vacant, Finset.disjoint_union_left, hu, hv]

noncomputable def mixed (b : ℝ) (z : Finset α → ℝ) :
    List (Finset α) → Finset α → ℝ
  | [], u => z u
  | h :: hs, u => mixed b z hs (u ∪ h) - b * mixed b z hs u

theorem mixed_atom (b : ℝ) (hits : Finset α) (hs : List (Finset α))
    (u : Finset α) :
    mixed b (fun v => vacant v hits) hs u =
      vacant u hits * (hs.map (fun h => vacant h hits - b)).prod := by
  induction hs generalizing u with
  | nil => simp [mixed]
  | cons h hs ih =>
      simp only [mixed, ih, vacant_union, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      ring

theorem mixed_sum (b : ℝ) (sample : Finset Ω) (w : Ω → ℝ)
    (z : Ω → Finset α → ℝ) (hs : List (Finset α)) (u : Finset α) :
    mixed b (fun v => ∑ ω ∈ sample, w ω * z ω v) hs u =
      ∑ ω ∈ sample, w ω * mixed b (z ω) hs u := by
  induction hs generalizing u with
  | nil => simp [mixed]
  | cons h hs ih =>
      simp only [mixed, ih]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ω hω
      ring

theorem exact_centered_mixed_moment (b : ℝ) (sample : Finset Ω)
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (hits : Ω → Finset α) (hs : List (Finset α)) :
    mixed b (fun u => ∑ ω ∈ sample, w ω * vacant u (hits ω)) hs ∅ =
      ∑ ω ∈ sample, w ω *
        (hs.map (fun h => vacant h (hits ω) - b)).prod := by
  rw [mixed_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω hω
  rw [mixed_atom, vacant_empty, one_mul]

theorem restricted_pair_sum_le_product (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)
    (w : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) (keep : α → β → Prop)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (hv : ∀ j ∈ t, 0 ≤ v j) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, if keep i j then w i * v j else 0) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) * (∑ j ∈ t, v j) := by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, if keep i j then w i * v j else 0) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, w i * v j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (hv j hj)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, w i) * (∑ j ∈ t, v j) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

theorem root_exponent (h r : ℤ) (hr : 10 * r ≤ h) :
    5 * (2 * r - h) ≤ -4 * h := by
  omega

theorem nonsimple_margin (k : ℚ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (17 / 50 : ℚ) * k ≤ 17 / 25 + (k - 2) := by
  linarith

theorem final_exponent_margin (z overhead : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (ho : overhead ≤ z / 10) :
    -(17 / 50 : ℝ) * z + overhead ≤ -(1 / 10 : ℝ) * z := by
  linarith

end PoissonCore
